scheme_name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Training Programme for Transgender
other_conditions: Applicant must be a transgender person
Applicant must meet the minimum age and educational qualification criteria set by the respective training institution
A maximum of two training courses can be availed under this scheme
benefits_summary: Provides vocational/technical training with training‑fee reimbursement and a monthly stipend of ₹5,000 for up to three months per course (maximum two courses).
